scenes.meaning: Discover and focus on one character.
The same character anchors a camera pullback into a layered crowd.
A depth field of conversations resolves into one named identity.
Same Pip conversation: yesterday, the user worried about sharing a song; Pip encouraged them.
Stay in the same conversation: retain yesterday’s user message, show today’s question from Pip, then the user’s You remembered reaction.
Choosing a personality changes the same character and its reply.
Voice selection changes the surrounding waveform.
An isolated prompt survives a device closeup, submit action, progress and result reveal.
The character anchors a moving background statement, then resolves into a glass story card ready to share.
The same story expands into a field of shared worlds.

motionNotes.arrivals: 10–16 frames; short optical settling, no bounce.
motionNotes.travel: Major cuts use 8–14 frame motion windows with overlapping departures and arrivals. Reading intervals and the 32-second score remain locked.
motionNotes.reading: The complete prompt remains readable for at least 1.2 seconds; messages persist while replies arrive.
motionNotes.continuity: Reuses the approved crowd pullback, depth-field identity pill, inclined conversation phone, extruded messages, macro submission, status/result reveal and portrait-to-card mechanisms. One character and one created story bridge those forms.
motionNotes.blur: Per-letter focus reveal plus velocity-derived object blur. Zero blur on readable holds. Exit defocus follows departing content, never the entire film.
motionNotes.type: Selective environmental type in the opening, talk beat, chosen personality, sharing accent and closing. No title for each feature. The share phrase travels behind the character.
motionNotes.composition: One visual anchor per beat: selected character, active conversation, recalled message, changed personality, voice source, typed input, created world, shared result. Supporting UI belongs to that object. No heading-plus-panel layouts.
motionNotes.crowdHandoff: Frames 72–104 overlap the shared pullback and ordered depth-field expansion. The hero and neighbouring avatars use the same camera.
motionNotes.conversation: One continuous thread, with old context followed by a specific remembered question and only then the reaction. User stays right, Pip left; the Pip avatar carries into personalization.
motionNotes.opening: Earlier statement exit at 1.37–1.70s, quick pullback lands at 2.60s, ordered depth field at 3.47s, Pip at 4.97s and phone at 6.13s. 8–14 frame transitions; musical accents sampled from the new score. Same user/Pip message timings and all scene timing after 7.10s.
motionNotes.rhythm: Four different rhythmic roles: short held setup then fast shared pullback; an exposed quiet memory reply; a compressed result reveal; and a delayed grouped community burst. Major actions get stronger accents than secondary UI.
motionNotes.duration: 30 seconds / 900 frames. Recover 0.8s from personalization, 0.6s from voice selection, and 0.6s from the result hold. Dialogue reading and speech speed are preserved.

sourceCoordinateNote: Source TSX uses authored-frame coordinates; timeMap converts output frames to these coordinates. Scene metadata below uses output frames.
